title: How to crop a video on iPhone
readerJob: To crop a clip in Vyra on iPhone, select it and choose Crop. Vyra adds a rectangle mask that controls the visible area. Check the subject at the start and end of the shot before you keep the crop.
source: Masks and Editing tools on iPhone

title: How to rotate a video on iPhone
readerJob: To turn a sideways clip upright in Vyra on iPhone, select the clip and use Transform, or ask chat to rotate that clip. Review the framing after rotation because the picture can leave empty space around it.
source: Editing tools on iPhone and Properties panel

title: How to flip a video on iPhone
readerJob: To mirror a clip in Vyra on iPhone, ask chat to flip that clip horizontally. Check writing, logos and the direction of the action afterward. A horizontal flip changes which side of the frame everything appears on.
source: Properties panel and Editing tools on iPhone

title: How to put two videos side by side on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, open Layout and ask for two clips side by side. Choose which recording goes in each cell, then check framing, timing and audio for both.

title: How to make a picture-in-picture video on iPhone
readerJob: Use Layout in Vyra on iPhone to put a small video over a larger one. Ask for a picture-in-picture arrangement and identify the main recording and the inset recording.

title: How to make a square video on iPhone
readerJob: To make a square video in Vyra on iPhone, tap the canvas size chip in the editor bar and choose the square canvas. Reframe each clip afterward so the subject fits.

title: How to fix black bars around a video on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, compare the clip shape with the canvas shape. Fit the whole picture when every edge matters, or enlarge and reframe the clip to fill the canvas when you can crop its edges.
source: Canvas resize, Layouts and Properties panel

title: How to change how long a photo stays in a video on iPhone
readerJob: In a Vyra iPhone project, change the duration of the photo item on the timeline or tell chat how long it should stay. Review the text and narration over the photo before shortening it.

title: How to duplicate a video clip on iPhone
readerJob: To reuse a shot in Vyra on iPhone, select its timeline clip and choose Duplicate. Check where the new copy appears and decide which part of the original recording each copy should show.

title: How to make a circular video overlay on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, use an ellipse mask to show a round area of a video, then position that masked clip over the main picture. Check the face throughout the shot.

title: How to brighten a dark video on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, select the dark clip and open Adjust. Raise the brightness carefully while checking both the subject and the lightest parts of the image.

title: How to fix an orange or blue video on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, select the clip, open Adjust and use the WB controls to correct its color cast. Compare an area that should look neutral while keeping skin and important colors believable.

title: How to fade music out at the end of a video on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, ask chat to lower the music gradually before the ending. Identify the music track and the point where it should become silent, then listen to the final export.

title: How to make video text readable with a shadow on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, ask chat for a small shadow behind the selected text. Review the words against the brightest and busiest frames the text crosses.

title: How to change a title font in a video on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, identify the title by its words and ask chat to change its font. Use a font available in Vyra and review the new line breaks before keeping it.

title: How to make a video overlay partly transparent on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, place the overlay above the background and change the selected clip’s Opacity. Review the resulting blend while both pictures move.
source: Editing tools on iPhone and Masks

title: How to rename footage in Vyra on iPhone
readerJob: To rename a media item in Vyra on iPhone, press and hold it in Library, open Assets and choose Rename from the item’s actions. Give the recording a name that helps you distinguish it from similar clips.

title: How to move footage into folders in Vyra on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, press and hold an item in Library, choose Move and select its folder. When selecting several items, the library’s bottom bar also offers Move.

title: How to add existing library footage to a Vyra project on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, locate the item in Library, press and hold it and choose Add to project. Check the destination project before you continue editing.

title: How to caption only the voiceover on iPhone
readerJob: In Vyra on iPhone, open Captions and choose Voiceover under Generate from. Set the spoken language and caption style, generate the captions and check them against the voiceover.
